title: Lexicographically smallest topological order
description: Implement topological_order(graph). graph is a directed graph given as a dict mapping each node (str) to an iterable of successor nodes. Return the lexicographically smallest valid topological ordering of every node in the graph.
invariants: A node that appears only as a successor is still part of the ordering.
When several orderings are valid, the lexicographically smallest one is returned.
Raises ValueError when the graph contains a cycle.
